title: Pirates
story: A sunny voyage past the treasure beach.

cards.name: Treasure Chest
cards.subject: A wooden treasure chest with a rounded lid opened wide, gold bands across it, a gold lock plate on the front, a red lining inside and a heap of gold coins filling it, standing on sand.

cards.name: Pirate Hat
cards.subject: A black tricorn pirate hat with three upturned brims, gold trim along the edges and a red feather tucked in a band on one side, seen from the front.

cards.name: Pirate Ship
cards.subject: A wooden sailing ship with a brown hull, three tall masts with white square sails, a small red flag on the top mast and a curved bow, floating on calm sea water.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, white sails, red flag
cards.surface_or_setting: open turquoise sea water under a clear sky

cards.name: Gold Pouch
cards.subject: A tan leather pouch tied at the neck with a red cord, bulging with round gold coins that spill out onto the floor in a small pile.

cards.name: Treasure Map
cards.subject: A flat rectangular parchment map lying on a table with slightly curled edges, a dotted path leading to a big red X, and a small palm island icon, seen from above.

cards.name: Spyglass
cards.subject: A brass telescope extended to three round tube sections of decreasing width, with a dark brown leather-wrapped grip and a round lens at the wide end.
cards.hero_colors: brass gold, dark brown leather, red band

cards.name: Ship Wheel
cards.subject: A wooden ship's helm with a perfectly round wheel of eight spokes with handles around the rim and a brass hub, mounted on a sturdy wooden post fixed to the deck.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, brass gold, red hub cap
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden ship deck with the sea and clear sky behind

cards.name: Anchor
cards.subject: A heavy dark iron anchor with a ring at the top, a wooden crossbar stock, a straight shank and two curved arms with pointed flukes, standing upright on wooden planks.

cards.name: Palm Tree
cards.subject: A single palm tree with a curved brown trunk, a crown of long green fronds and a cluster of brown coconuts, growing on a sandy beach beside turquoise water.
cards.surface_or_setting: sandy beach with shallow turquoise water behind

cards.name: Parrot
cards.subject: A scarlet macaw flying with wings spread wide, long tail feathers trailing, a curved beak and yellow stripes across the wings, with green tips on the wings.
cards.hero_colors: scarlet red, yellow, green wing tips
